note: Horse-and-RV campground on Flynn Creek Road 4 miles southeast of Custer, by the Black Hills trail system: 100 covered stalls in barns around the edge, with horses kept out of the camping loops. A playground, a group pavilion and an outdoor kitchen. One RV and one car per site. --Claude
summary: Operator site read: RV sites (full hookup and w/e) $59 for 2 (+$3), equestrian $49 + $15 stall, monthly $1,450; 2027 season May 1-Oct 1; phone booking; bathhouse, laundry, store, wifi, dump. Over $50 but Wind Cave NP 19 km (gateway passes). Google 4.9 (224). A horse camp at heart, but horses are confined to perimeter barns and a perimeter path - flagged for the horse rule, not proposed as a drop. Amperage not stated (stored 50 unconfirmed).
flags: HORSE RULE (reviewer call, not proposed as a drop): the operator brands itself 'Broken Arrow Horse Camp' / 'BROKEN ARROW HORSE AND RV CAMPGROUND' with '100 covered stalls in multiple barns' and equestrian site rates. Horse sites are not a separate loop on the campground map (the numbered sites 1-12, 17-40 and A-G are one layout; equestrian vs RV sites are not marked), BUT horses are kept out of the camping area: 'Barns are located around the perimeter of the campground', 'No riding or leading horses through campground. Must use designated perimeter.', 'No tying to trailers in campsite, or unloading in non-barn area.' Reads as horses explicitly separated from the camping (barns + perimeter path), so a keep under the 2026-11-12/17 rulings in my reading; quoted for the reviewer.

PRICE GATE (private): cheapest RV night $59 for two before tax (no RV site cheaper; the $49 equestrian site is for guests stabling horses) - over US$50, but gateways.py finds Wind Cave NP 19 km and Mount Rushmore 21 km: passes on the gateway rule. Not a Good Sam Park (stored good_sam false). Google 4.9 from 224 reviews. RV Life 5*, price tier 2 (avg 38).

LONG-STAY: a monthly RV rate ($1,450) and monthly equestrian packages are posted; season is May-Oct only; no wording discouraging nightly guests, nightly rates first on the page. Nightly share not measurable from the pages; nothing suggests mostly seasonal.

HOOKUPS: operator pages say 'Full Hook-Up, Pull Though & Water/Electric Sites' but give no amperage; stored electric 50 (derived from the old note's 'some 30-amp, some 50-amp') is unconfirmed by current pages. Hookups group not written.

SITES: campground map shows numbered RV sites 1-12 and 17-40 plus lettered sites A-G (43) and one tent site; stored note's '40 pull-through' not confirmed by the current pages (amenities say pull-through sites exist). Sites group not written.
DISCOUNTS: stored military true (Good Sam directory); the operator's site posts no RV discounts (the cabins page says 'No Discounts Available' for cabins).
WEBSITE/PHONE: confirmed (http://www.brokenarrowhorsecamp.com/ works; 605-517-1964 on every page). An https URL would be tidier but was not tested as different.
